lenses.description: subset of the profile lens catalog to run

isLibrary.description: true if a published library (→ semver-checks); always false where not applicable

intent.description: what the change should do, from the brief/args; empty if unknown

churn.description: hot/often-changed files to scrutinize; may be empty

repoRules.description: repo-relative paths of the repository's own rule files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, …); paths only; may be empty

notes.description: one line on what was detected

crossBoundarySymbol.description: diff changes the signature/shape of an exported/pub symbol that unchanged code depends on

wireForm.description: diff changes a contract another version reads, calls or deploys against — CRD schema or API version, serde type, HTTP/OpenAPI, protocol, CLI flag/exit code/output format, config key, env var, Helm value, changed default, renamed exported name

invariantType.description: diff changes a type that carries an invariant other code relies on
